scope: immutable CPU routing admission for provisional signal-net candidates; not complete commercial design qualification
design_binding: The frozen run manifest binds policy objects to the DCP footprint, native graph and mapping hashes. Header architecture fingerprint alone does not identify the design; host raw sidecar length checks do not authenticate that provenance.

full_native_objects.header: shared FPGAACCP 64-byte header, schema 0.1, native CSR architecture fingerprint and CRC64/ECMA-182

terminal_net.bin.record: little-endian footprint net ID; 0xffffffff means no exclusive candidate pin owner

pip_protection.bin.index: full native PIP catalog ID, NOT CSR arc ID

clock_intents: dictionary names beginning NODE_GLOBAL_, or CLKPIN, GLOBAL, BUFGROUT, REFCLK; original candidate footprint must pass without exceptions
terminal_ownership: every candidate source/sink pin node is permanently reserved for its net across rip-up; different candidate nets sharing a terminal node reject conversion

runtime.API: shared immutable RoutingPolicy supplied to RRBackend, SpeculativeBackend and route_wide_pathfinder_edges

host_sidecars..node_protection: one raw u8 per PR node
host_sidecars..terminal_net: one raw little-endian u32 per PR node
host_sidecars..edge_protection: one raw u8 per PR CSR edge

runtime.mapping_requirement: When constructing a PR view, map native nodes to its node order and expand native pip_protection[edge_ref >> 1] into each directed CSR edge. Never copy the native PIP-indexed table as the CSR-edge table. Full-view conversion is not implemented by this schema alone.
runtime.activation: any host sidecar requires all three, exact lengths, edge identity and 64-bit costs; there is no overuse override
runtime.search: hard-denied nodes/edges omitted from local, flat and reverse-lookahead expansion and corridor proposals; foreign terminal seeds reject
runtime.commit: current proposal paths independently rechecked before any write; policy-required proposals cannot use policy-free commit; stale snapshots remain replayable
runtime.epochs: protected occupancy, capacity, owner, version and logical u64 costs unchanged during initialization, rip-up and all congestion epochs; cost fields in the PR resource record remain reserved zero under the existing wide-state ABI
runtime.sources: incoming native arcs do not make a source invalid; exclusive terminal ownership prevents other nets borrowing it

full_graph_audit: every provisional original candidate pin, PIP and task must pass the policy; counts include all directed arcs before net-specific and remaining site/tile admissibility checks
remaining: full PR graph/view packing and commercial workload routing
DCP writeback and native design legality/QoR
